$comment: Execution-loop bookkeeping for automated contributors. Not consumed by the
crate at build or run time; nothing in src/ or tests/ reads this file.
Kept in-tree so a later cycle (or a different session) can see what has
already been tried and, more importantly, what was tried and REJECTED —
the rejected list is the part that stops cycles rediscovering the same

Red since 2026-08-02 on one rustdoc error; root cause was structural, not a typo: a commit inserted `struct AbortOnDrop` between `TrackedEntityMap`'s 26-line doc comment and the struct, so AbortOnDrop adopted another type's documentation and `Self::take_dirty` could not resolve. Moved the block back rather than rewriting the link. 5 merge conflicts resolved per-hunk on evidence.

cycle_1_slots.instruction: Decide and record the DbWriter unbounded-channel question (OD-1).
cycle_1_slots.status: COMPLETE — DECIDED: keep the channel unbounded, and disclose a pathological backlog. Bounding it would force try_send (drops events, breaking the flush() contract) or an async submit() at a sync engine call site. The queue is also already bounded in practice by DEFAULT_MAX_ENTITIES=2500 and the wall-time watchdog. The real defect was that a storage stall was INVISIBLE, so writer_loop now discloses queue depth past BACKLOG_WARN_EVENTS=1024 with hysteresis at half.

rejected_candidates.candidate: OD-3 — wire benches into CI so perf regressions are visible
rejected_candidates.reason: Premise was wrong, verified empirically: `cargo check --all-targets --locked` — which ci.yml's check job already runs — DOES compile both benches (confirmed by touching them and watching the rebuild; `--lib` does not). So they are already guarded against perf-path API drift, exactly as CLAUDE.md states. What is genuinely absent is EXECUTING them for regression detection, and that is not a defensible increment on shared GitHub-hosted runners: Criterion variance there is large enough that a threshold gate produces false failures — the same "gate that passes while measuring the wrong thing" failure mode cycle 1 slot 4 existed to remove. Needs dedicated hardware or a statistical baseline, not a workflow line.

If event production outpaces sqlite batch writes the queue grows without bound, on a platform whose whole point is a memory-constrained no-root Android device. Exposure INCREASED when #315 raised DEFAULT_SCAN_DEPTH 3->5, since more rounds means more events.

open_defects.severity: high — defeats the stated purpose of `hse export --redact`
open_defects.evidence_level: L4 — reproduced in-tree; password redacted to '[redacted]' while uid stayed a2beb73b… = SHA-256('hunter2'); coordinates coarsened -27.470125,153.021072 -> -27.5,153.0 while uid still fingerprinted the full-precision original
open_defects.detail: Entity.uid is hex(SHA-256(kind + ':' + normalise(value))) (core/entity/mod.rs:468). redact_credential and redact_coordinates (util/redact.rs) rewrite value/raw_value/evidence but never touch uid, and api/scan_export/mod.rs:156 emits uid as a CSV column. A --redact export therefore ships an unsalted hash of the exact plaintext beside the redacted value. For coordinates this is practically reversible: coarsening to 1 d.p. bounds the original to a 0.1x0.1 degree box, ~1e10 candidates at 6 d.p. against an unsalted SHA-256.
open_defects.why_not_fixed_this_cycle: BLOCKED — larger than scoped, and every obvious fix breaks something else. app/export/renderers.rs:317 builds a HashMap keyed by entity uid to label relation endpoints, and the relations come from store.relations_for_scan() carrying the ORIGINAL uids. So (a) any change to entity.uid breaks the relation->entity join in the GEXF/graph export, and (b) naive recompute-from-redacted-value collapses every redacted credential of a kind to one uid, so that HashMap keeps only one entity and relations resolve to the wrong label. A correct fix must return an old_uid->new_uid mapping from redact_entities and remap relations' from_uid/to_uid in lockstep at all three renderer call sites — an API change to the redaction pass, not a local edit.
options_considered: recompute from redacted value (collapses credentials; breaks relation join)
per-export salted uid (preserves distinctness; breaks relation join harder)
open_defects.status: open — needs a decision on the redaction API before implementation

open_defects.evidence_level: L4 — enumerated exhaustively; every cited docs/*.md path checked against the filesystem
open_defects.detail: 26 references to 11 docs/*.md files that do not exist, across 18 files including src/lib.rs:21 and tests/architecture.rs. Missing: ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT(3), CONVENTIONS(4), MODULES(2), OPENAPI_SCHEMA(1), PROBLEM_TREE(3), REGISTRY-API(1), RUNTIME_INDEPENDENCE(3), SEEKNOW_INTEGRATION_SUMMARY(2), SOLUTION_TREE(2), USAGE(3), data_retention_design(2). Several cite SECTION NUMBERS of the nonexistent document (e.g. paths.rs 'PROBLEM_TREE §7 S3', doctor/mod.rs 'CONVENTIONS.md §5', cert_intel 'PROBLEM_TREE.md §3.F').
open_defects.why_it_matters: CLAUDE.md directs contributors (human and agent) to these docs as authority. An agent following 'see docs/CONVENTIONS.md §5' finds nothing and may invent the convention. This is a fabrication vector in a repo whose constitution forbids fabricating sources.
open_defects.prescribed_fix: Do NOT author the 11 documents — that would fabricate authority that never existed. Strip the dangling path from each citation while KEEPING the substantive prose (most already quote the rule inline, e.g. 'no HashMap-iteration-order leaks into output'), and redirect pure pointers ('full charter in docs/RUNTIME_INDEPENDENCE.md', 'See docs/USAGE.md for the full reference') to the real enforcement site — tests/architecture.rs guards, `hse --help`, `hse modules` — which CLAUDE.md already declares the source of truth. 26 sites, each needing individual judgement; not a regex pass.
